explanation: The rename work adds one step: a dataset that changes the nomenclature table also needs pnpm run build:search-names, which regenerates the search names and the rename groups from nomenclature.tsv; project guidance states the order, the --check guard and the rule tests. The rebuilt renames.js and names.js come from the same nomenclature table with the case-duplicate rule; the dataset steps and the --check guard are unchanged.
